Question: Consider a series that follows an MA(1) with zero mean and a moving average coefficient of 0.4. What is the value of the autocovariance at lag 1?

Options: 
A. 1
B. 2
C. -0.4
D. The autocovariance at lag 1 is undefined for an MA(1) series.
E. 0.2
F. 0.4
G. The autocovariance at lag 1 is always equal to the moving average coefficient.
H. 0.34
I. 0.6
J. It is not possible to determine the value of the autocovariances without knowing the disturbance variance.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
